scope: A persona's daily pool cycle no longer admits a trial member directly: it opens a risk-persona consultation through the C4 trigger engine, and a later cycle admits only on the verified published memo. Paper only; no model call on the trade path; no new credential or route.

changes.shared_verification: services/persona/consult_triggers.py: verify_published_memo (extracted from HarnessAdoption.verify; gate recomputed from each participant's transcript, adopt_eligible, all-approve) plus trial_admission_requirement / trial_admission_decision_id (binds artifact_ref, checksum, pool version) and pool_membership_signature. HarnessAdoption.verify now calls the shared function (behaviour and error codes unchanged).
changes.cycle: services/persona/pool_autonomy_cycle.py: PoolAutonomyCycle._consult_gate; HttpPoolCyclePorts.trial_admission_consultation (opens as persona:<id> via open_persona_panel once per candidate+live membership; verifies published memo later), queue_operator_decision (evolution proposal flag_for_review, idempotent on 409). Pending/operator outcomes are memory outcomes admission_pending / admission_operator_decision and never a tried family (TRIED_OUTCOMES).
changes.owner: services/control-plane/persona/persona_strategy_pool.py: PoolDecisionRequest.initiated_by / consultation_memo_id / consultation_pool_version; a persona-initiated (or persona-pool-cycle actor) admit is refused without a memo that the owner itself verifies with the shared function; applied decisions carry consultation_memo_id and evidence_refs. Operator-initiated admission unchanged.
changes.design_note_pool_version: The daily risk reweight appends a pool version every cycle, so a consultation bound to version V stays valid only while the live membership (ref, checksum, stage; not weights) is identical at the later version; otherwise it is stale and a new consultation opens. The memo's decision id still binds the version it was opened against, and the owner re-verifies against it.

limitations: The consultation owner boundary and provider answers are test fixtures (FakeConsultationOwner); no hosted consultation service run is claimed.

A candidate held by an operator decision stays the first fresh candidate each day (receipts repeat as already_queued) until the operator resolves it; it is not yet filtered out of candidate selection.
Deployment must provide the consultation owner URL/token to the persona service; unconfigured fails closed with consultation_unavailable.
